item.title: Saverne
item.description: Saverne is Gabriel Kreuther’s modern wood-fired French brasserie using traditional techniques of letting wood flames add layers of smokiness to seasonal ingredients. Saverne actually opened a while ago around March 2026, but it closed just after 8 days due to mechanical issue. It just reopened in July 2026. Having been to Gabriel Kreuther, the chef’s Michelin 2-star restaurant, we were quite excited to see what he had in mind for a more casual outing. One of the main allures of the restaurant was that it has a wood-fire oven and grill where they cook your meats and then prepare your food. We made a reservation for 2 easily for 6 PM on a Friday evening.

item.title: Claud
item.description: For this week, I offered my partner an option of European or Chinese. Of course they said European. Claud comes from 2 veterans of the Momofuku Ko restaurant, chef Joshua Pinsky and wine expert Chase Sinzer. I remember this restaurant a while back, but it slipped off my radar with all these new openings in the last few years. When I checked Resy, I noticed there were openings on Friday, so the stars aligned. We were able to get a reservation for 2 for 5:15 PM on a Friday relatively easy.
